QuestInfo.name: Another Mission From Neinheart
QuestInfo.0: Looks like Neinheart has another favor to ask.
QuestInfo.1: Neinheart says the monsters on Victoria Island are acting strange. Take down 80 Cold Eyes in the North Forest Lot and examine them.
QuestInfo.2: You investigated the Cold Eyes in the North Forest Lot.

0.0: Mihile, there have been reports of monsters on Victoria Island acting strangely. They're moving in an organized manner, and more aggressively than we're used to... Would you investigate the Cold Eyes in Ellinia?

yes.0: Go to the North Forest Lot in Ellinia and hunt #b#e80 Cold Eyes#k#n, examine them, and report back to me.

no.0: Now is not the time for a change of heart.

1.0: Did you find anything suspicious?\r\n#L0##bThe monsters alone were not much different from before, but I can definitely tell that they are increasing in population. They're also moving in an organized manner.#l\n#k
1.1: I see. If this is all true, we'll need to carry out a more thorough investigation. Thank you for your work.

mob.0: Go to the North Forest Lot in Ellinia and hunt #b#e80 Cold Eyes#k#n, examine them, and report back to me.
